snippet.title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7 and Friends All💎
snippet.description:
All💎
Fireboy and Watergirl 7: And Friends brings the classic teamwork puzzle series back with a fresh temple adventure, new characters, and smarter level design. Fireboy and Watergirl are no longer alone this time. Three helpful friends join the journey, each bringing a special ability that changes how you solve puzzles, reach platforms, press buttons, and escape dangerous chambers.
Across 36 challenging levels, you must guide the characters through lava, water, toxic green goo, moving platforms, buttons, levers, narrow tunnels, tilting beams, and tricky jumps. Every level is built around cooperation. Sometimes Fireboy and Watergirl must work together as usual, and sometimes their new friends become the key to finding the exit.
You can play this game here:
https://www.fireboynwatergirl.com/?p=game&id=7
